datasets.title: Tiomena Particulate Matter PM10 (CAMS)
datasets.description: This dataset provides the sub-daily atmospheric concentrations of particulate matter with a diameter smaller than 10 micrometers (PM10).
datasets.purpose: This dataset was developed during the first phase of GRMA's project in Madagascar. This project aimed at updating Madagascar's risk profile, and see the risk evolution under climate change.
datasets.details: This dataset is used as a proxy for dust storms occurence, it is extracted over Madagascar from the CAMS global reanalysis EAC4 (ECMWF Atmospheric Composition Reanalysis 4) at a 0.75° resolution, available from 2003 to 2023 (Inness et al., 2019). Daily average values were computed to produce the statistics.

author_names: Inness, A., Ades, M., Agustí-Panareda, A., Barré, J., Benedictow, A., Blechschmidt, A.-M., Dominguez, J. J., Engelen, R., Eskes, H., Flemming, J., Huijnen, V., Jones, L., Kipling, Z., Massart, S., Parrington, M., Peuch, V.-H., Razinger, M., Remy, S., Schulz, M., and Suttie, M.
referenced_by.name: The CAMS reanalysis of atmospheric composition

resources.title: CAMS Reanalysis
resources.description: CAMS global reanalysis EAC4 (ECMWF Atmospheric Composition Reanalysis 4) in netcdf format.

resources.title: Crops location
resources.description: High resolution land cover from ESA's WorldCover data v200. The field crops grid points are extracted to describe agricultural regions that could be exposed to Tiomena.
